usedFor: Lettermint sends email, and “Send Email” delivers a message to a specified recipient from another step's data.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Send Email” in Lettermint
bestTemplate.why: Each incoming message can start an email to a specified recipient.

watchOut: “Send Email” reaches someone outside the business, so it waits in Needs you for your approval.
